name: Portolan Chart
desc: An antique portolan sea chart whose signature web of rhumb lines radiates from sixteen wind roses set on a hidden circle, red, green and black loxodromes crossing into a shimmering lattice that slowly wheels; a wandering coastline is combed with perpendicular place-name ticks and red port dots, an ornate compass rose turns at the center, and a drifting pool of candlelight moves over the stained parchment.
